scientific_integrity: Self-contained derivation plus finite, exact-integer checks; the finite tests do not replace the infinite proof. Independent audit is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the signed classical Rudin–Shapiro sequence and dyadic factor lengths 2^k, k≥2. Previously known maximal and minimal sums are explicitly excluded from the claimed contribution. No non-dyadic first-location or all-extremizer classification is claimed. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: First-attainment locations for dyadic extremal Rudin–Shapiro factors
